description: John Kroll is a lifelong Wisconsinite that is running for the State Assembly in the 2026 election. As a husband, father, and public servant, John cares deeply about the direction of Wisconsin and wants working families to have a chance at the American dream.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of John Kroll, John Kroll, Treasurer
title: John Kroll for Assembly | Wausau, Wisconsin | Assembly District 85
